scope: Structural stream/emitter discovery in all core src/http/** and src/storage/**; supplemental canonical transport/timer discovery throughout core src; package tsconfig; no operation allowlist or callee suppression

discoveryContract.supplementalScope: Canonical transport types and timer bindings throughout every core src TypeScript source
receiverTypeFamilies: Node stream.Readable, Writable, Duplex, Transform and PassThrough
Node events.EventEmitter and structural emitter interfaces, including Companion EmitterLike
Structural stream interfaces with any callable stream/emitter member
Web ReadableStream/WritableStream/TransformStream, readers/writers/controllers (DOM globals and node:stream/web declarations)
FastifyRequest/FastifyReply, their raw transports and reached descendants
Inherited/generic/constrained/union/intersection types, type/import aliases, Promise/PromiseLike/Awaited wrappers and reached property/call descendants
discoveryContract.operations: All receiver calls/references/writes/constructions; async/sync iteration, yield delegation, independent argument handoffs and explicit/implicit returns; nested callees always visited
discoveryContract.consumption: for await / for of; Symbol.asyncIterator / iterator and next/return; pipeline / finished (callback and promise); Readable.from / compose / addAbortSignal; events.once / on; pipe source AND targets; every local/foreign function or constructor argument; explicit/arrow/aggregate/asserted/awaited returns; yield/yield*, spread and await using; AbortController/Signal and options wiring
discoveryContract.exclusions: Structural-only families outside HTTP/storage roots remain outside structural scope. Dynamic eval, any/unknown without typed/lexical origin, unconstrained generics and unresolved conditional/indexed types cannot reveal a concrete receiver statically. No valid resolved typed consumption form is excluded.
discoveryContract.typeResolution: Each canonical/structural classification follows checker.getAwaitedType, aliases, union/intersection members, generic constraints and inheritance. Web families match declaration file plus name in TypeScript lib.dom/lib.webworker and @types/node/stream/web.d.ts, including imported/namespace aliases.
discoveryContract.timers: Canonical set/clear Timeout, Interval and Immediate bindings, aliases and AbortSignal.timeout
discoveryContract.unclassified: Generation and --check both fail before publishing an inventory

boundaries.owner: CoreService.ts; Application service resource; persistence/application owner retains service work independently of HTTP transport

restoration.hooks: Shared service streams, deadlines and outbound cancellation do not bypass Fastify hooks; they execute beneath an accepted action or an independently owned job.
restoration.session: No raw session publication. An HTTP caller retains its ordinary session/callback ownership independently of service cancellation.

restoration.drain: Service operation/finalizer and resource owner retain stream iterator/pipeline/completion/EOF/error settlement and outstanding work; argument/return/producer handoffs do not release the HTTP request or dependency frontier. restoration.hooks: Terminal faults deliberately bypass serializers/send hooks and do not manufacture recursive onError. Normal pre-error hooks may already have run; malformed requests/upgrades may precede them. Native onResponse remains for constructed HTTP replies.
restoration.session: Opaque failure publishes no success cookies or failed session mutation. Accepted session operations remain request-owned; deliberate public denials use ordinary send/session hooks.
restoration.observation: Fixed redacted HTTP_REQUEST_FAILED diagnostic; safe socket refusal contains no exception text. Native onResponse once where a request exists; no synthetic route metrics for parser-level socket errors.
restoration.drain: Raw end/destroy signals the same response lifetime; existing asynchronous handler/session/logger work is still retained independently.
restoration.security: Safe status/body/header allowlist, HEAD/committed-response handling; no second send owner or untrusted error headers.
restoration.upgrade: Socket target is the shared terminate path for malformed/denied/unknown upgrade failures.

restoration.security: Capability seal rejects unqualified stream/callback handoffs; no new raw registration capability.
restoration.upgrade: Server emit admission precedes sole owner dispatcher; close detaches integration listeners.

restoration.hooks: Shared service streams, deadlines and outbound cancellation do not bypass Fastify hooks; they execute beneath an accepted action or an independently owned job.
restoration.session: No raw session publication. An HTTP caller retains its ordinary session/callback ownership independently of service cancellation.
restoration.observation: Service observes its own completion/error; HTTP callers retain the one native response/error observation.
restoration.drain: Service operation/finalizer and resource owner retain stream iterator/pipeline/completion/EOF/error settlement and outstanding work; argument/return/producer handoffs do not release the HTTP request or dependency frontier. Cancellable timers clear in finally/close, awaited delays settle before release, and AbortSignal.timeout owns its unreferenced expiry.
restoration.security: No new inbound listener or raw header writer; upstream guards and service-specific validation continue to apply.
restoration.upgrade: Not an upgrade path; no host upgrade listener is acquired.

boundaries.owner: FastifyHost / requestOwnership; sole listener and transport-close attempt

restoration.hooks: Root admission runs before every raw listener. Sealed callback/producer qualification retains accepted work even after hijack/response/disconnect.
restoration.session: Session and callback work retained by shared request lifetime/store owner.
restoration.observation: Shared error boundary + redacting logger; asynchronous observations and sink work remain owned. Hooks cannot replace terminal responses.
restoration.drain: Stop intent closes admission, single transport-close attempt, request drain plus dependency-ordered application cleanup; deadline retains ownership, explicit retry, idempotent success.
restoration.security: Capability seal rejects unqualified stream/callback handoffs; no new raw registration capability.
restoration.upgrade: Server emit admission precedes sole owner dispatcher; close detaches integration listeners.
